$$f(x) = \frac{3}{4}(1 - x^2)$$
```{r}
n <- 1e3
gerar_epanechnikov <- function(n) {
  x <- numeric(n)
  
  for(i in 1:n) {
    
    U1 <- runif(1, -1, 1)
    U2 <- runif(1, -1, 1)
    U3 <- runif(1, -1, 1)
    
    # (ii) Algoritmo de Devroye e Györfi
    if(abs(U3) >= abs(U2) & abs(U3) >= abs(U1)) {
      x[i] <- U2
    } else {
      x[i] <- U3
    }
  }
  return(x)
}
```

```{r}
n <- 1000
set.seed(650) 
amostra <- gerar_epanechnikov(n)

cat("Média amostral:", mean(amostra), "\n")
cat("Desvio padrão amostral:", sd(amostra), "\n\n")
```
```{r}
d_epanechnikov <- function(x) {
  ifelse(abs(x) <= 1, (3/4) * (1 - x^2), 0)
}
hist(amostra,breaks=30)

```
